observations: A used automatic transmission housing (gearbox) is shown on a concrete floor.
The housing is dirty, dusty, and has some surface rust.
A metal bracket with a 'VINCO AUTO SPARE PARTS' watermark is visible on both photos.
No Lexus brand markings, model labels, or identification plates are visible on the housing in the photos.
The item appears to be a used or second-hand part, not a new OEM unit.

claims.evidence: No Lexus branding or model identification plate is visible in the photos.
No origin or country-of-origin stamp is visible on the housing.
No pin count or pin configuration is visible on the housing.
No manufacturing or production date stamps are visible on the housing.
A guarantee is a promise of service, not a physical proof of existence.
Strength cannot be determined from a photo of a used part.

claims.claim: Tokunbo, direct from Belgium. Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The item may be a generic or used part rather than a genuine Lexus OEM part.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacturer's identification plate (usually on the back or side).

risks.risk: The gearbox may be missing the necessary shift solenoid or other internal components.
risks.proof: A photo of the complete assembly with all internal parts.

risks.risk: The gearbox may be used or refurbished rather than new.
risks.proof: A photo of the original factory seal or the 'New' stamp on the housing.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the manufacturer's identification plate on the back or side of the housing.
Photo of the complete gearbox with all internal parts.
Photo of the original factory seal or 'New' stamp.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
